summary: Asana apps are registered in the developer console; you set the name, redirect URL and scopes at registration and can change them later. Redirects must be HTTPS (localhost needs PKCE), scopes use a resource:action format, and access tokens last one hour with refresh tokens. The OAuth docs describe no review process, but the app must be available in a user's workspace before they can authorize it.
key_facts: Register in the developer console (My apps) to get a client ID and secret; the secret can be reset from the OAuth tab
Non-native apps must use an HTTPS redirect URL; localhost and native redirects also require PKCE (S256)
Scopes use resource:action (e.g. tasks:read); requesting an unregistered scope returns forbidden_scopes; requests are not additive
You can instead enable Full permissions, but then individual scopes cannot be requested
Access tokens last 1 hour (expires_in 3600); refresh tokens renew them without user action
The token exchange must happen on your server because it needs the client secret

steps.title: Create the app
steps.description: In the developer console open My apps and create an app to get the client ID and secret.

steps.title: Set the redirect URL and scopes
steps.description: Register an HTTPS redirect URL (for Composio: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback) and the scopes your app needs, or enable Full permissions.
warnings: Requested scopes must be on the registered list

steps.title: Make the app available to users
steps.description: The app must be available in the user's workspace before they can authorize it; see Asana's manage-distribution documentation.

steps.title: Authorize and exchange the code
steps.description: Send users to https://app.asana.com/-/oauth_authorize, then POST the code to https://app.asana.com/-/oauth_token from your server.

steps.title: Refresh tokens
steps.description: Exchange the refresh token with grant_type=refresh_token before the one-hour access token expires.

blockers.title: forbidden_scopes error
blockers.description: Requesting a scope that is not on the app's registered list fails with forbidden_scopes.
blockers.workaround: Add the scope in the developer console or request a subset of the registered ones.

blockers.title: Distribution details are not on the OAuth page
blockers.description: The OAuth documentation refers to a separate "manage distribution" page for making the app available to other workspaces.
